nom: Vichy Normaderm Daily Deep Cleansing with Salicylic Acid

avis.texte: Unfortunately, this cleanser caused deep painful breakout. I'm not sure what in the ingredients was responsible but this was the only product that changed in my routine. I used it twice and after using it at nighttime, I noticed the toning pad had picked up more post-cleansing than usual. So I guess it doesn't clean as well or perhaps one of the ingredients just didn't agree with my skin. I would proceed with caution. The good thing is the PC 2% salicylic acid is helping to bring down the spot.

Made me break out bad, especially on my forehead. My cheeks were inflamed. Not sure why if this was just a "first-time flop" but not sure if I want to try it again since it really did harm to my skin.
Great lather, gentle and effective. Keeps my skin clear and is the perfect cleanser in my routine. Helps prevent acne and makes my skin soft and doesnt dry me out in the Montana winter.

I have super sensitive combo skin. This stuff works well to remove makeup, lathers nice, and smells slightly minty. It doesnt break me out, but if used too much it is slightly drying. I alternate this with another cleanser.
Wouldn't reccomend to my acne girlies! It cleans off my skin but it doesn't do a thing to my acnes!

avis.titre: A decent cleaner but would not purchase again
avis.texte: This cleanser did nothing for my acne. It claims to reduce the number of blackheads and acne blemishes and improve texture and tone, but I have been using it 1-2x daily for about 5 months and have not noticed my skin looking better. It gets the job done for taking makeup off and cleansing skin.

If they ever stop selling this face wash, I'm not sure what I will do! This cleanser has been a game changer for my adult hormonal acne. This face wash does smell like tea tree oil, so I'm not sure if that is a product in here (I need to look!). I will say as a disclaimer that my face purged really bad when I started using this, but one it cleared up it has stayed clear. This wash suds up on my face amazingly as well. This was the first face wash I have tried from this brand, and it led me to purchasing their Thermal face wash as well. I use that first to make sure my makeup is completely off and then I go in with this as my second cleanser. I hope people continue to purchase this, so it stays on the market!
Only the cleansing gel that helps my son with acne, works great!

Let me start with how fabulous it smells, considering it helps with acne I certainly love love love smell of it! Now it's absolutely gentle on my skin, cleaned really well and it felt super soft and smooth after just first use. In my opinion top notch cleanser and helped with my very oily skin. I use it at night and my skin felt fresh and clean right away. I used Vichy since I was a teenager and I love the quality of their skin care, including this cleanser, just outstanding!

avis.titre: No more oily skin and less pimples.
avis.texte: I love it, Im 22 and I've always been struggling with oily sensitive acne prone skin since 16 and this cleanser helped me so much. My skin is looking healthier, less oily but still luminous, way less pimples.

Using the product twice a day for 25 years, there is nothing better!!!!! If you have oily skin and pimples this is your best friend. There is not other company make it a better quality product at this price point.

This cleanser is a MUST HAVE if you have oily skin. My skin is not only clearing up, but I no longer have to deal with shiny, oily skin throughout the day! I received a sample with a beauty purchase I made, and ran out to buy the largest size I could find right away!

avis.titre: Why I have been using Normaderm for 10 years!
avis.texte: Despite having dry skin and, fortunately, not having acne, I have been using this facial gel for ten years. I like the way it foams up and leaves my face feeling really clean and free of makeup. I use Pond's Cold Cream to remove eye makeup and foundation, etc. I follow that with washing my face with Vichy. It is the best. I do use a serum and moisturizer after rinsing the Vichy off.
I really feel refresh, clean after using this product. However, I did notice bumps on my face after 1 week or so using it. I think, if you are sensitive, , may not be an ideal product for you.
It's a good cleanser, smooth on the skin and it lets the face without any oiliness, love it!

avis.titre: Made skin super irritated and red - even more breakouts!
avis.texte: This product burned the skin on my face so badly it was bright red. It irritated my face so badly and led to more breakouts. I would not recommend this product.

avis.titre: Perfect one step cleansing for the most sensitive dry skin
avis.texte: I actually got a sample of this last year from ULTA, and so glad I gave it chance since it does say it's for oily skin - but I've had problems with acne breaking out if I use the wrong kind of cleanser even if they're specifically made for dry skin. I need a very delicate balance between feeling like all the day's dirt and my skincare and makeup is all completely off without doubt but not leaving my skin dried out. For reference the FAB face cleanser breaks me out after one use and the Drunk Elephant jelly cleanser leaves my skin dried out and suffering immediately as well. The other French Pharmacy staple brands' cleansers don't suit my needs either: LRP's Toleraine one feels a bit drying and doesn't get makeup off perfectly in one go, and Avene's gentle lotion leaves a film that makes me keep feeling like my skin is dirty & doesn't do well against makeup or sunscreen. So a very tough job to find the cleanser suited to me. This cleanser saved my skin when I was suffering from my damaged skin barrier causing constant breakouts - so my skin was in immense constant pain as well. This gel cleanser is so good that I barely need a dot to lather all around my face and neck to get every last drop of anything on my face off - including mascara. I really like how this lathers to spread a lot but it isn't foamy to the point I can't see exactly how my skin products are coming off or where I need to spread cleanser to. This never causes any stinging despite having BHA in it which is such

avis.titre: Works great but I don't like the smell
avis.texte: At 75 years young, I never thought I'd develop oily skin, but I had problems with persistent oil clogging the pores in my naso-labial folds, upper lip and chin. Nothing I did seem to work and even cleansers designed for oily skin did not work at all. So I decided to try products with salicylic acid in them, ordered this cleanser and this did work! Along with a 2% salicylic acid serum, my skin was once again clear and new clogged pores stopped appearing. I alternate this cleanser with a 2% salicylic acid cleanser and it keeps my skin balanced and clog free. My only complaint is the smell. It is not pleasant, smells a little like "dirt" or composting plants - but since my skin likes it (no redness or peeling) and it works, I'll keep using it. Just PLEASE - do something about the smell!
I have been using it for one week and my skin feels better than ever I am soooo happy with this product amazing I definitely recommend it.

I have combo skin. In my mid 50's. I've only started using this face wash so I can't comment on any actual results. But what I can tell you the scent is lovely!!! Like a soft rain over a floral/citrus garden. I hate anything with a heavy scent especially before bed. This is relaxing and makes me "want " to wash my face before bed. The sudsy lather is perfect as well and it's not drying.

This cleanser comes in a thin clear gel consistency. It smells slightly metallic and herbal. It lathers slightly but not excessively. It does the job cleansing the skin, but is not a standout product for me. I find it slightly drying and overall, average in performance.
After trying many other products, Murad, Tula, Kiehls, and Kate Sommerville, these products work the best for me.

I never thought I'd get to a point in life where a zit for me was rare, but I have and I really think this product has helped! I highly suggest trying it if you have acne-prone skin!

I love this Deep Cleansing Gel with Salicylic Acid I use it baceuse I have a oily skin and it clean all my face all the way down and it feel great after use it and have a fantastic fragance.

I'm more confidant wearing tank and halter tops now.

I'm extremely pleased with this product range. I had combination skin with breakouts on my jawline, checks and had dark makes left due to the breakouts. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a combination product, and hope this helps someone as much as it has helped me. Extremely happy customer all the way from South Africa.
Really nice texture, doesn't dry out skin after use, and I definitely can feel the results: the pores on my face, especially on my nose, are producing less oil now and getting less clogged.

I think this would be better suited for someone with oily skin versus my skin which tends to be somewhat dry. I will finish this bottle. avis.titre: My pores are clean and happy!
avis.texte: Gifted by Vichy in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this cleaner 2x per day (along with the moisturizer) for 2 weeks. For some background, I'm mid 30s, combo skin, slightly acne prone. I love trying new cleansers because it's the one product I can (usually) switch up in my routine without risking wrecking my skin, and I'm absolutely adding Normaderm to my rotation. My makeup and sunscreen came off easily, so no need for a double cleanse. I did have to use some micellar water to get off the last scraps of eye makeup, but that's normal for me. I use primer, dark shadow, waterproof liner and mascara, and lash glue, so science hasn't even invented a cleanser which can tackle that mess in one go. In addition to doing an excellent job of cleansing without leaving my skin dry or stripped, I noticed the huge pores I've always had around my T-zone have gotten smaller. Still visible, and definitely far from perfect, but I'm really excited to keep using Normaderm and see what improvements the next few weeks bring!

avis.titre: Foams up well, doesn't dry out skin!
avis.texte: My skin used to be much more acne prone than it is now but even in my late 30's, I still experience blackheads and breakouts. Ugh! I also have combination skin - oily in some areas, dry in others - so finding that perfect product that doesn't leave my skin looking shiny or flaky can be tricky. The Normaderm PhytoAction Daily Deep Cleansing Gel is a lightweight gel formula that does a great job cleansing my skin without drying it. Most acne cleansers clean well but leave my skin feeling stripped of moisture and overly tight. I have been using this for around a month and have noticed some results. Granted, my skin isn't in really bad shape like it used to be but I do have some blemishes and also some minor blackheads around my nose area. When used in combination with the Vichy Laboratories Vichy Laboratories Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Moisturizer, my problem areas have pretty much vanished. No more blemishes, no more blackheads (which is HUGE), and my pores appear to be considerably smaller. I was getting frustrated at first because I didn't see results for awhile. So, keep trying! The deep cleansing gel foams up nicely. You don't need to use a lot to work up a nice lather. (1-2 pumps was plenty for me) The scent is light and fresh smelling. After rinsing, my skin felt soft, clean, fresh, and best of all, not overly tight or dry. Overall, I was quite impressed with this product and would highly recommend it to anyone that is dealing with pesky acne breakouts and b
